cause: Both failures reached Database.connect sidecar pathname validation while concurrent SQLite final-connection cleanup unlinked a WAL/SHM/journal file; os.stat returned private ordinary inode metadata with st_nlink=0 and _check_private rejected it. No collection errors remained.
sidecar_fix: For sidecars only, validate zero-link inode privacy and re-stat the current name up to 3 times; accept ENOENT, reject changed unsafe entries. Main database and ordinary file checks remain strict.

focused.coverage: All foundation storage tests, positive read-only reconciliation variants and exact hosted ENOSPC case; includes sidecar symlink/hardlink/fifo/public/directory and ordinary unlinked-file refusal, plus SQLite file-lock preservation.

remaining_gate: One hosted broad regression after the sidecar source freeze.
